## How Codex Should Use 100x Dev

- Full reusable workflows live in `.agents/skills/<slug>/SKILL.md` so Codex can load them on demand.
- When the user names a 100xprism slash workflow like `/gate`, treat it as a request to use the matching skill in `.agents/skills/`.
- Prefer explicit skill invocation (`$gate`, `$commit`, `$test`, etc.) or `/skills` when available; custom prompt slash commands are intentionally not generated.
- The generated `.agents/100x-index.md` contains the full module catalog when you need to browse available skills.
- Codex hooks, when generated, live in `.codex/hooks.json`. Review and trust them with `/hooks` before expecting enforcement.
- Claude Code plugins in `plugins/plugins.json` are not Codex plugins. Use Codex `/plugins` for Codex-native plugins and app/MCP integrations.
